# 聯燈會要

**ID:** X1557

**Category:** 史傳部類

**Byline:** 宋 悟明集
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279

## Contributors
- 悟明 (A000929)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The fourth of the five canonical Sòng Chán lamp records, in 30 juan. Wùmíng, a Dharma heir in the Línjì — Yángqí — Dàhuì 大慧 line, compiled the *Liándēng huìyào* ("Gathering Essentials of the Linked Lamps") as a synthesis of the three earlier lamp records and a supplement bringing the genealogy up to the late twelfth century.

**Abstract**

Structurally a condensation and updating of the *Jǐngdé chuándēng lù* ([KR6q0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0003)), *Tiānshèng guǎngdēng lù* ([KR6q0004](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0004)), and *Jiànzhōng jìngguó xùdēng lù* ([KR6q0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0007)), with additional figures down through the mid-twelfth century. Distinctive for its more compressed entries (several earlier masters are represented by only a single famous dialogue rather than by a full entry) and for its privileging of the Dàhuì line within the post-1100 Línjì expansion — [大慧宗杲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%A7%E6%85%A7%E5%AE%97%E6%9D%B2) Dàhuì Zōnggǎo (1089–1163) receives one of the longer and more detailed individual entries.

The work was prepared under the patronage of the literatus [王渙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E6%B8%99) Wáng Huán and circulated widely in the late Southern Sòng; it was incorporated into the Korean Tripitaka 高麗藏 and into the Xuzangjing. It is the most historiographically modern of the pre-*Wǔdēng huìyuán* 五燈會元 lamp records, in the sense that its coverage of contemporary Línjì masters was the most up-to-date available at the time of compilation, and [普濟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%AE%E6%BF%9F) Pǔjì drew heavily on it in compiling the *Wǔdēng huìyuán* in 1252.
